metadata.title: Privacy Policy | Interasis AI
metadata.description: Understand how Interasis AI handles data and protects visitor privacy.

title: Privacy Policy
summary: This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect visitor information on the Interasis AI website.

dataCollected.heading: Data collected
dataCollected.content: We may collect information voluntarily provided by you through contact forms or chat interactions. We also use essential cookies for site operation.

usage.heading: Use of information
usage.content: The information collected is used exclusively to enhance your experience on the site and respond to contact requests. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties.

security.heading: Security
security.content: We employ technical and organizational measures to protect your data. The site uses secure connection (HTTPS) and secure development practices.
